relevance.rationale: The seeded-orphan classification is WRONG for this file: the ref() entry exists (references.ts L128-140, id garoufalidis2004, the entry's own note names it 'the AJ-conjecture formulation paper') and it is load-bearing — two Lean files carry `-- Ref: [garoufalidis2004]`: folio/quantum-observable-universe/stochastic-mechanics/phi-q-aj-machinery-identification.lean and lean/QOU/BraidKnot/AJTrefoil.lean. I confirmed the identification against the document's own front matter: it introduces the characteristic variety from q-holonomicity of the colored Jones function, compares it to the SL_2(C) character variety viewed from the boundary, states that comparison as a conjecture, and verifies it by direct computation for the trefoil and figure-eight. That matches both Lean consumers exactly (AJTrefoil.lean is the trefoil case §3.1). Note the citation is Lean-only — there is no .md citation site — so a reader of the narrative cannot see where the AJ formulation comes from. That is the one gap worth closing.

keyResults.statement: The conjecture identifying the characteristic variety of the colored Jones function with the SL_2(C) character variety seen from the boundary is verified by direct computation for the trefoil 3_1 and the figure-eight 4_1.
keyResults.useForFolio: This is precisely the case AJTrefoil.lean formalizes; the paper is the source for the trefoil verification the Lean file assumes rather than proves.

keyResults.statement: A noncommutative version of the A-polynomial (the A_q polynomial) is defined from the recursion satisfied by the colored Jones function.
keyResults.useForFolio: Backs the 'AJ machinery' identification made in phi-q-aj-machinery-identification.lean, whose -- Ref: already points here.

proposedActions.rationale: The reference is cited only from Lean; the narrative block backing the AJ/characteristic-variety machinery has no visible source. Add the citation on the .md side of the phi-q-aj-machinery-identification block.
